issues.detail: Main article is unavailable; coverage is limited to target-specific SI preparations and controls.
issues.subject: article

issues.detail: Preparation of the R-gossonorol ketone precursor is referred to prior literature; that upstream sequence is not reconstructed from imagination.
issues.subject: ketone

issues.detail: Yields are combined sample yields. No individual isolated yield is assigned to an enantiomer or diastereomer, and a single mixture experiment is not split into multiple reactions.
issues.subject: all events

issues.detail: The precursor preparation has three scale-dependent yield/ee results. The 87% ee example is retained as the main path because it matches the stated hydroperoxidation substrate; the other examples remain metadata.
issues.subject: E01/E02

issues.detail: Racemic 6 is supplied as starting material for the control cyclization. Its upstream preparation is not a separately quantified target-specific example here.
issues.subject: E05

issues.detail: S-6 is the minority enantiomer of reported scalemic R-6 and a component of the racemic control. Its graph is derived by inversion, not claimed as an isolated or separately drawn sample.
issues.subject: 6S

issues.detail: The source uses an oxidized samarium iodide solution with a proposed peroxide reagent identity. No discrete catalyst structure or mechanistic reaction is asserted.
issues.subject: E03/E05

issues.detail: Ligand synthesis, substrate scope, screening, titration and mechanistic control procedures are outside the natural-product route dataset.
